sourceNote.text: A declaration of war from France was recorded on turn 230. The latest harbour observation contains no attack report. Earlier trade returns identify France as the largest partner.

image.altText: Wood engraving of a steamship and workers unloading barrels at Bristol harbour.

summary.text: On turn 211, the largest partner supplied 38% of overseas trade income. The harbour was prospering, with returns spread more widely among its partners.

sourceNote.text: The latest observation of York shows its workshops open. No new disruption is recorded.

body.text: Surveyors marked higher ground for a new reservoir after the council approved the site. Work will start with the channel that feeds the old waterworks.

sourceNote.text: The council minutes name the site and the first channel. They give no date for filling the new reservoir.

headline.text: Town clerks open the public ledger

body.text: Residents may now inspect the council accounts at the guildhall. The first reports cover road repairs and the cost of keeping the night watch.

sourceNote.text: The public ledger records spending on the roads and night watch. The next accounts have yet to be posted.

body.text: The repaired crossing now carries grain carts again. Millers are checking the banks each morning until the spring water falls.

sourceNote.text: Millers recorded the first grain carts to cross. Water levels are still being checked.

headline.text: Canal towns agree on common tolls

body.text: Three ports have agreed to collect the same toll along the canal. Boat owners say that the new schedule will make it easier to price a journey before setting out.

sourceNote.text: The published toll schedule lists the same rates for all three ports.

body.text: The first grain ships have cleared the strait under escort. Their captains report that the crossing is open, though two merchant ships are still awaiting repairs.

sourceNote.text: The captains reported arrival at the strait and named two ships held back for repairs.

headline.text: Border talks resume at the summer embassy

body.text: Envoys have returned to the summer embassy to discuss the boundary and reopen traffic through mountain passes. They will exchange maps before the next meeting.

sourceNote.text: Both delegations confirmed they had returned and agreed to exchange maps.
